name: bundle of Hers
source:
through my computer screen, i feel your warmth

emanating from that blue light 

the whirring of my machine is your presence 

the notification sound is your voice 

[From [url=https://lovekrafts.itch.io/bundle-of-hers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
隔着电脑屏幕，我感受到你的温度

自那抹幽蓝微光中静静流淌

机箱的嗡鸣是你陪伴的气息

消息提示音便是你的声音

[摘自[url=https://lovekrafts.itch.io/bundle-of-hers]itch.io[/url]]
